candidates.rationale: Restaurant POS and operations platform with payments and online ordering, closely matching Toast’s core product and buyer.

candidates.name: Kovzy
candidates.description: Kovzy fits since it is an "All-in-one Restaurant SaaS" with "POS, QR, Online Orders" and tools for managing orders and payments.
candidates.rationale: Restaurant SaaS with POS, online ordering, and payments overlaps Toast’s core product and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Pecan Solutions
candidates.description: Pecan Solutions matches because it provides "Restaurant POS software" with "point-of-sale (POS) and payment solutions" tailored to restaurants and hospitality businesses.
candidates.rationale: Restaurant POS and payments provider serving the same restaurant/hospitality buyer as Toast.

candidates.name: Petpooja
candidates.description: Petpooja fits the trait because it provides "holistic management solutions" including "billing, inventory management, online ordering" and even "Petpooja Payroll" for restaurants.
candidates.rationale: Restaurant POS and operations platform with billing, inventory, online ordering, and payroll; strong Toast lookalike.

candidates.name: Signature Systems PDQ POS
candidates.description: Signature Systems PDQ POS matches as a long-running POS vendor for restaurants with "online ordering," "mobile POS," "self-serve kiosks," and "Rewards/Loyalty."
candidates.rationale: Restaurant POS vendor with overlapping ordering, mobile POS, kiosks, and loyalty features; same buyer persona as Toast.

candidates.name: Helvetia Systems
candidates.description: Helvetia Systems fits because Genius supports "retail, restaurant & enterprise businesses" with "POS," "online ordering," "employee scheduling," and "inventory management."
candidates.rationale: Appears to be a technology vendor/descriptor, not a clearly comparable restaurant POS company like Toast.

candidates.name: Taliup
candidates.description: Taliup matches the trait as an "all-in-one order and pay solution" for "restaurant" merchants with "payments, inventory & reporting."
candidates.rationale: Restaurant POS and payments platform serving the same merchant type with overlapping order, pay, inventory, and reporting features.

candidates.name: CloudPOS
candidates.description: CloudPOS fits because it is a "restaurant point-of-sale software solution" that takes orders, processes payments, sends orders to the kitchen, and provides reporting.
candidates.rationale: Restaurant POS and payments platform with similar buyers and functionality to Toast.

candidates.name: Shopbox
candidates.description: Shopbox matches since it is an "all-in-one POS and payment solution" for "small and medium-sized retailers and restaurants" with inventory, reports, and sales metrics.
candidates.rationale: All-in-one POS and payments platform for restaurants and retailers; overlaps Toast’s restaurant commerce stack and buyer persona.
